# ShaderX agent instructions

Follow the repository's `AGENTS.md` for every task. Read `CLAUDE.md` for the
architecture and `docs/contributing.md` for commands.

Update the relevant documentation and public KDoc in the same PR as behavior,
API, platform, dependency or sample changes. Use the change-to-guide table in
`AGENTS.md`. Preserve the README banner and all four inline sample recordings.
Run the documentation checks listed in `AGENTS.md` before finishing.
